title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Right groin and upper thigh from above, patient supine, seen from the foot of the bed: head at the top, lateral on the image left, medial on the right. Draped, with a window over the groin.
teachingPoint: Linear probe transverse over the femoral crease, over the femoral vessels with the nerve lateral to the artery under it; needle in-plane from lateral to medial, entering just beyond the probe's lateral end.
claims: Right groin from above, seen from the foot of the bed: head at the top, lateral left, medial right - the same way round as the anatomy plate. Adapted from the approved FICB layout.
Purple: the ASIS, the pubic tubercle and the inguinal ligament between them (dashed). Red dashes: the surface course of the femoral artery.
Linear probe transverse at the femoral crease, just below the inguinal ligament (record, steps 1), over the artery (centring added).
Needle entering just lateral to the probe, in line with it: in-plane from lateral to medial (record, steps 4).
Three labels: ASIS, Inguinal ligament, Femoral artery.
